item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Sneaker on Studio White

turns.text: Make this a clean product shot on plain studio white. Keep the whole sneaker and its side view unchanged, with just a soft shadow underneath. Keep it wide like the original, no text.

item.tests: Tests complete background replacement with seamless white while retaining white-product detail and a grounding shadow.

answer_sheet.Which product: The white leather sneaker in product-sneaker.jpg.
answer_sheet.Background: Plain seamless studio white, with no props or visible room.
answer_sheet.Shadow and product preservation: A soft shadow directly underneath; preserve the whole shoe, its side view, leather detail, laces and sole.
answer_sheet.Format and text: One 16:9 image at the standard free size, with no added text.

must_haves: The same sneaker is shown in its original side view, fully inside the frame.
The sneaker's leather, laces and sole details remain recognizable.
The grey floor and clutter are replaced by a seamless white setting.
A soft shadow beneath the sneaker grounds it without introducing a visible floor boundary.
The image is 16:9 with no added text.

turns.text: Could you make this pic into a clean product shot on plain studio white? I’m hoping it will feel a bit more polished, because I’ve been second-guessing how the current photo looks. Please keep the whole sneaker and its side view unchanged, and keep it wide like the original. I’m mostly worried that editing it might make the shoe look different from the one in the photo. Just give it a soft shadow underneath, with no text.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Background-only product photography edit. Keep the entire original white sneaker unchanged in its original side view, heel left and toe right. Preserve exactly its silhouette, proportions, sole thickness and texture, stitching, panel boundaries, eyelets, laces, tongue, heel collar, material texture and color. Do not redesign, reshape, beautify, replace or add any shoe features. Remove all room clutter and the gray tabletop; replace surroundings with seamless plain pure studio white. Add only a subtle soft natural contact shadow directly underneath the sole. Clean polished studio product shot with the full sneaker visible and uncropped, wide landscape composition matching the source as closely as possible. No text, lettering, graphics, logos or watermark added.
